onb_desc1: LIVERA transforms CO2 into fresh O2 using advanced microalgae technology.
onb_desc2: Monitor air quality, nutrient levels, and algae health in real-time.
onb_desc3: Harvest nutrient-rich biomass and learn via our Algae Academy.
hist_log_calibration_desc: All sensors re-calibrated for Tank A
light_ai_desc_optimal: Light levels are optimal for current biomass density. No action needed.
light_ai_desc_low: Light intensity is too low. Increasing intensity recommended.
light_ai_desc_high: Light intensity is too high. Ensure CO2 supply is sufficient to prevent photoinhibition.
pow_saving_desc: Reduces aeration and light intensity when idle.
pow_monitor_desc: Tracks battery voltage and cycles continuously.
harv_card1_desc: Harvest fresh algae for consumption as a high protein and chlorophyll supplement.
harv_card2_desc: Harvest concentrated algae liquid as a natural nutrient to fertilize your ornamental plants.
prep_desc: Prepare a 500ml container and a micron filter cloth. Ensure all tools are sterile to maintain supplement quality.
drain_desc: Slowly open the drainage valve, then collect about 20% of the green liquid (±500 ml) into a sterile container. Once finished, close the valve tightly.
filt_desc: Pour the collected algae liquid through your micron filter cloth. Gently squeeze the cloth to remove excess water until a thick green paste remains.
stor_desc: Transfer the paste to a sealed jar. Store in the refrigerator for up to 3 days or freeze for longer. Mix a teaspoon into water or smoothies for a nutrient boost.
fert_drain_desc: Take about 1 liter of concentrated algae liquid from the bottom valve. This liquid is rich in Nitrogen and micro-nutrients to trigger leaf growth.
fert_mix_desc: Mix 1 part concentrated algae liquid with 10 parts clean water. Dilution is important to prevent nutrient burn on your plants.
fert_apply_desc: Pour directly onto the planting medium. Use once a week for maximum results. Your plants are now receiving the best organic nutrients.
fert_prep_desc: Prepare a dilution bottle and watering tools. No need to be sterile like food, but ensure containers are clean from chemical residue.
harv_status_desc: Monitor your algae growth and harvest readiness.
help_faq_1: What to do if biomass level is low?
help_ans_1: Check light intensity and ensure NPK nutrient supply matches the dosage.
help_ans_2: Open the Device Setup menu in Settings, then press the Re-pair Device button.
help_faq_3: How do I update the firmware?
help_ans_3: Updates are available in the Device Setup menu if a new version has been released.
help_ans_4: Daily reports include algae growth efficiency and pH stability.
help_ans_policy: Contact our team within 7 days of receiving the item for a unit replacement.
help_faq_billing: Where can I find my invoice or billing history?
help_ans_billing: Invoices are sent to your registered email or can be downloaded in the Impact Dashboard.
alert_desc: Monitor air safety and get notified instantly when levels exceed your preferred limits.

alert_pm25_msg: Alert me if PM2.5 exceeds {} µg/m³
alert_nutrition_desc: Automated reminders for routine nutrition refills to ensure your algae remains healthy, active, and doesn't deteriorate.

vip_benefit2_desc: Gain full access to exclusive microalgae biotechnology educational materials inside the app.
vip_benefit3_desc: Connect and monitor as many LIVERA devices as you want. (Free Plan is limited to max 2 devices).
vip_benefit4_desc: As a VIP Owner, invite unlimited family or team members to monitor your devices seamlessly.
vip_footer: By subscribing, you support the circular economy (algae biomass for supplements). Terms & Conditions apply.
